name: Car Workshop — Fase 4
description: Saga de OS nos 3 microsserviços: ordens, saga, pagamentos, DLQ, API e infraestrutura. O filtro de filial vale para as 3 primeiras páginas.

pages.name: Ordens de Serviço
pages.description: Métricas do os-service por filial. Toda série nasce com zero no boot do pod.

widgets.title: OS por status ao longo do dia

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_status_changes_total) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) FACET status TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: OS abertas hoje

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_status_changes_total) AS 'OS abertas' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) AND status = 'RECEIVED' SINCE today

widgets.title: Tempo médio por etapa, em segundos (aproximação: cada média vem de um grupo diferente de OS)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'UNDER_DIAGNOSIS') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'UNDER_DIAGNOSIS') AS 'até o diagnóstico', filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') - filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'UNDER_DIAGNOSIS') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'UNDER_DIAGNOSIS') AS 'diagnóstico até o orçamento', filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT') - filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') AS 'aprovação', filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') - filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT') AS 'pagamento', filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') - filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum), WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') / filter(sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count), WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS 'reparo' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Tempo médio da abertura até cada status (segundos)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum)/sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count) AS 'segundos' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) FACET status SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Tempo médio da abertura à conclusão (segundos)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_completion_time_seconds_sum)/sum(workorder_completion_time_seconds_count) AS 'segundos' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Transições por status

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_status_changes_total) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) FACET status SINCE 1 day ago

pages.name: Saga
pages.description: Gauges lidos da tabela saga_instance a cada 30 s. Os 2 pods reportam o mesmo valor: latest, nunca sum.

widgets.title: Sagas por estado agora

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(saga_instances) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) FACET state, branch SINCE 10 minutes ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Sagas paradas além do prazo (o alerta vigia; esperado 0)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(saga_overdue) AS 'paradas' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) FACET branch SINCE 10 minutes ago

widgets.title: Sagas em andamento ao longo do tempo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(saga_instances) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) AND state NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'COMPENSATED') FACET state, branch TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Compensações por motivo (sagas canceladas no banco)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(saga_compensations) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND branch IN ({{branch}}) FACET reason, branch SINCE 10 minutes ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Parada além do prazo

rawConfiguration.text: **Conta como parada:** `AWAITING_APPROVAL` ou `AWAITING_PAYMENT` com o prazo vencido há mais de 2 min, ou `COMPENSATING` sem mudança há mais de 15 min. A varredura de prazos roda a cada 30 s, então mais de 2 min vencido indica que ela não está compensando.

pages.name: Pagamentos
pages.description: Contados pela linha "<evento> published for Work Order" do billing-service, uma por mensagem publicada.

widgets.title: Pagamentos por desfecho

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'PaymentRequested published for Work Order%') AS 'cobranças criadas', filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'PaymentConfirmed published for Work Order%') AS 'confirmados', filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'PaymentAttemptRejected published for Work Order%') AS 'tentativas recusadas', filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'PaymentRequestFailed published for Work Order%') AS 'cobranças não criadas', filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'PaymentCanceled published for Work Order%') AS 'cancelados', filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'PaymentRefunded published for Work Order%') AS 'estornados (0 na sandbox, ADR-008)' FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'billing-service' AND context.branchId IN ({{branch}}) SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Eventos de pagamento ao longo do tempo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'billing-service' AND context.branchId IN ({{branch}}) AND message LIKE 'Payment% published for Work Order%' FACET capture(message, r'(?P<evento>Payment[A-Za-z]+) published for Work Order.*') TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Recusas e falhas nos últimos 15 min (o alerta abre com 3)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'recusas e falhas' FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'billing-service' AND context.branchId IN ({{branch}}) AND (message LIKE 'PaymentAttemptRejected published for Work Order%' OR message LIKE 'PaymentRequestFailed published for Work Order%') SINCE 15 minutes ago

pages.name: DLQ
pages.description: Profundidade das 3 DLQs, lida pelo serviço que consome a fila de origem. Não tem filial.

widgets.title: Mensagens nas DLQs (o alerta vigia; esperado 0)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(saga_dlq_messages) FROM Metric FACET queue SINCE 10 minutes ago

widgets.title: DLQs ao longo do tempo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(saga_dlq_messages) FROM Metric FACET queue TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Mensagens deixadas para o redrive, por serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE message LIKE '%leaving it for the redrive policy%' FACET entity.name TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Como tratar

rawConfiguration.text: **DLQ com mensagem:** leia o envelope e classifique pelo `runbook-redrive-dlq.md` (os-service, `docs/arquitetura`) antes de reenviar ou descartar. O contexto da falha está no log: `FROM Log WHERE context.sagaId = '<sagaId do envelope>'`.

pages.name: API
pages.description: Os 3 serviços. Erros vêm de Transaction (a métrica perde a primeira amostra de cada série); latência e vazão vêm da métrica.

widgets.title: Falhas 5xx por serviço (o alerta vigia)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE http.statusCode >= 500) AS '5xx' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND request.uri NOT LIKE '%/q/%' FACET appName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: 5xx na última hora

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE http.statusCode >= 500) AS '5xx' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND request.uri NOT LIKE '%/q/%' FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Recusas por regra de negócio (4xx): não são falhas

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'requisições' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND http.statusCode >= 400 AND http.statusCode < 500 FACET appName, request.uri, http.statusCode SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Latência média por serviço, ms (métrica: a série nova perde a 1ª amostra)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(http_server_requests_seconds_sum)/sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count)*1000 AS 'ms' FROM Metric WHERE app IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND outcome = 'SUCCESS' AND uri NOT LIKE '%/q/%' FACET app TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Requisições por serviço (métrica)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count) FROM Metric WHERE app IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND uri NOT LIKE '%/q/%' FACET app TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Mensagens consumidas por fila e tipo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'mensagens', filter(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'com erro' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND name LIKE 'OtherTransaction/Message/%' FACET appName, name SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 30

widgets.title: Pods respondendo ao scrape

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(pod) AS 'pods' FROM Metric WHERE app IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') AND metricName = 'up' FACET app SINCE 10 minutes ago

widgets.title: Réplicas desejadas e prontas (HPA)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(podsDesired) AS 'desejadas', latest(podsReady) AS 'prontas' FROM K8sDeploymentSample WHERE clusterName = 'fiap-fase4-eks' AND deploymentName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') FACET deploymentName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: CPU por pod, % do request (alvo do HPA: 60%)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(requestedCpuCoresUtilization) AS '% do request' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'fiap-fase4-eks' AND containerName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') FACET podName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Memória por pod, % do request (HPA em 80%; acima de 53% a 3ª réplica não desce)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(requestedMemoryUtilization) AS '% do request' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'fiap-fase4-eks' AND containerName IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') FACET podName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Uptime por pod

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(up) FROM Metric WHERE app IN ('car-workshop-api', 'billing-service', 'execution-service') FACET app, pod TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

nrqlQuery.query: SELECT uniques(branch) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'workorder_status_changes_total' SINCE 1 week ago
